public_findings.fact: Bring-your-own agent can compete in the same Optima run over HTTP.
public_findings.limitation: No request/response/authentication/file-lifecycle endpoint schema is published on the visible product page.

public_findings.fact: Optima uses Artificial Analysis benchmarking infrastructure and supports agentic benchmark construction/grading.
public_findings.limitation: Does not publish the BYO-agent HTTP protocol and does not make Optima results equivalent to official private AA-Briefcase v1.1.

public_findings.fact: The public Try Optima path redirects through account login.
public_findings.limitation: No unauthenticated public endpoint contract was exposed there.

public_findings.fact: Public repo contains Optima benchmark-prep skills and ZIP upload handoff instructions.
public_findings.limitation: The repo documents eval-prep/upload, not the runtime HTTP agent contract.

public_findings.fact: Stirrup custom clients implement generate(messages, tools), model_slug, and context_window_tokens.
public_findings.limitation: This is an LLM client protocol, not proof that official AA-Briefcase accepts Brain's entire full-agent system over that boundary.

public_findings.fact: Custom benchmarking explicitly includes technical testing for models listed and not listed in public benchmarks.
public_findings.limitation: The contact page does not itself confirm independent no-fee AA-Briefcase acceptance or the full-agent transport contract.

conclusion.reason: The only published full-agent transport fact is 'over HTTP'; the authoritative endpoint contract, official-AA-Briefcase eligibility, no-fee acceptance, and frozen-1822 comparability binding remain owner-controlled.
